main.projectDescription: This is my Portfolio. This project refers to this website and the research I have put into it.

categories.categoryDescription:
This React project was created to learn more about HTML and have full control of the contents within a public website.

Each project page reads a Json file and maps out the information to be easily interpreted.

Each project's Json file has a title and a list of 'categories', where each list item describes one aspect of the project.

There is also an option to include game build data for anyone to experience the project first hand.

cards.cardDescription: This features a large picture to show more important content.
The side grid layout has text and pictures on either side of the screen. This can be flipped for more variability.
This displays a list of content in a simple grid format.
This allows the user to scroll through a list of items.
